BiblicalUsage: Shotet is a scourge, and it appears once, in Joshua's farewell warning. If Israel makes peace with the nations left in the land, those nations will be scourges in their sides and thorns in their eyes until Israel perishes from the good land.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a tolerated snare becomes a scourge, and the things we refuse to drive out will drive us out instead.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
